reasons: Status is correctly characterised as 'missing': the cited Section 9 (Warranties) and the surrounding paragraphs contain no cap, exclusion-of-damages or aggregate-liability language, and the rationale confirms 'liability' appears only in the no-joint-venture clause, so both Parties would otherwise face unlimited direct and consequential exposure.

The inserted 9(c) reaches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable by the Company under Section 3 or USD 1,000,000, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and uncapped Excluded Claims covering confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, plus the carve-out that the Company's Section 3 payment obligations are not capped damages.

Direction is correct for us as Customer (Deerskin 'Company'), with HDI as the hosting provider — the cap is mutual rather than one-sided, no unlimited-Customer-liability language is introduced, and the fee basis is tied to amounts the Company pays under Section 3 (consistent with the payment carve-out drafted).

Edit is minimally invasive: a single new subsection appended after 9(b) with no rewriting of existing warranty text, which is the smallest edit available where no liability clause exists; placement in Section 9 is defensible and the rationale ties it to the Section 10.7 survival period.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required [Playbook] prefix, states the position and the 12-month fee-cap fallback with core carve-outs, and does not misdescribe the contract.
